skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the basic concepts of responsible tourism development, including responsible business management, accommodation, food services, and tourism management.
Understand and analyze the basic content of laws and charters related to ethics and social responsibility for all parties involved in tourism and hospitality.
Understand the role, necessity, standards, and methods of building business ethics in the tourism and hospitality industry.
Analyze business environment issues related to environmental, social, and economic issues, as well as stakeholder issues for tourism businesses.
Demonstrate a serious attitude in learning and career development, with a responsible, honest, and disciplined work ethic.
Respect traditional culture, customs, and actively preserve and promote cultural values.
Actively and proactively build ethical standards and social responsibility for individuals and organizations.
